audit.reasoning: Deciding quote confirmed verbatim at NUSA 33 p. 29 in the scan we hold (now also saved under our files). The classification (fixed-strict penultimate, domain = phonological word incl. suffixes) rests on the primary fieldwork phonology article and is independently restated, more strongly ('invariably penultimate, irrespective of affixation'), in the 2012 SIL reference grammar §2.7 p. 13, which we hold under our earlier reading but which the catalog record does not cite and whose 'grade' field is blank. No better or conflicting source exists per Glottolog and web search. Action: add van den Berg & Busenitz 2012:13 §2.7 as a second confirming citation and set the strength of the evidence accordingly; fix the PW formula transcription to '((S̀) S) Ś S'. Minor refinement only: 2012 describes secondary stress as alternating leftward rather than initial-only; primary-stress coding unaffected.
